CREATE TABLE `biz_tx_log` (
  `tx_serial_no` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '平台流水号',
  `term_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '终端编号',
  `teller_no` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '柜员号',
  `dev_catalog` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '设备类型标识',
  `area` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '银联标准地区代码',
  `channel_id` varchar(300) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '交易通讯前置微服务名称',
  `tran_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '交易代码',
  `tran_type` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易简码',
  `org_no` varchar(11) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '机构编号',
  `primary_account` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易账号',
  `ident_tp` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '证件类型',
  `ident_no` varchar(25) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '证件号码',
  `mobile_phone` varchar(15) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户手机号',
  `client_no` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户编号',
  `cur_code` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易币种标识',
  `amount` decimal(24,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易金额',
  `settle_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '清算日期',
  `tran_day` tinyint NOT NULL COMMENT '交易日，分区列，0-31',
  `tran_date` date NOT NULL COMMENT '系统日期',
  `tran_time` time NOT NULL COMMENT '系统时间',
  `acct_trs_out` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '转出账号',
  `acct_trs_in` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '转入账号',
  `card_medium` tinyint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易卡介质标识',
  `agent_type` tinyint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易代理类型标识',
  `card_flag` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '卡标识:001-本行借记卡；002-本行贷记卡；003-单位结算卡；004-结算存折；005-储蓄存折；998-他行卡',
  `acct_trans_flag` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '动账交易标识',
  `agent_svr_lg` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '代办业务标识',
  `entry_mode` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '服务点输入方式标识',
  `orig_tx_serial_no` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原交易流水号',
  `comm_seq_no` varchar(2000) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发送方通讯流水号集合',
  `trs_seq_no` varchar(2000) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发送方交易流水号集合',
  `main_trs_seq` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '发送方交易流水号',
  `global_seq_no` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '全局流水号',
  `app_biz_seq_no` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户应用流水号',
  `app_biz_name` varchar(300) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '应用业务名称',
  `net_flag` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '转发渠道编号',
  `svr_sys_cd` varchar(2000) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '目标系统编号集合',
  `resp_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '响应码',
  `tx_status` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '交易状态标识',
  `term_serial_no` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '终端流水号',
  `term_reconciliation` tinyint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '终端对账标识',
  `term_batch_no` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '终端批次号',
  `term_date` date NOT NULL COMMENT '终端上送日期',
  `term_time` time DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '终端上送时间',
  `host_serial_no` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主机交易流水号',
  `host_resp_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主机响应码',
  `host_resp_msg` varchar(2000) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '后台响应信息',
  `host_settle_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主机账务日期',
  `host_reconciliation` tinyint DEFAULT '-1' COMMENT '主机对账标识',
  `host_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主机交易日期',
  `host_time` time(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主机交易时间',
  `comp_trace_no` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '第三方交易流水号',
  `comp_resp_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '第三方响应码',
  `comp_settle_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '第三方账务日期',
  `comp_reconciliation` tinyint DEFAULT '-1' COMMENT '第三方对账标记:-1-不参与对账；0-未对帐；1-已对帐平；2-对账未平；3-账务存疑；4-账务分析无差错；5-对账分析存疑',
  `comp_date` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '第三方交易日期',
  `comp_time` time(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '第三方交易时间',
  `cups_batch_no` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '银联批次号',
  `auth_teller` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '授权人柜员号',
  `req_svr_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '接入方标识，用于标注S端的主机编号',
  `platform_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '平台编号',
  `custom_trans_lg` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '主交易标识',
  `main_tran_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '主交易简码',
  `voc_status` tinyint DEFAULT '-1' COMMENT '业务凭证状态标识',
  `trs_fee` decimal(24,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易手续费',
  `reverse_flag` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '冲正标识',
  `afms_serialno` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '反欺诈查验跟踪流水号',
  `large_font_tag` char(1) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '字号标识：0-常规版；1-大字版',
  `tx_bgn_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '交易开始时间',
  `tx_end_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '交易结束时间',
  `note1` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备用字段1',
  `note2` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备用字段2',
  `note3` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备用字段3',
  `note4` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备用字段4',
  `note5` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备用字段5',
  PRIMARY KEY (`tran_day`,`tran_date`,`tx_serial_no`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_biztxlog` (`tran_day`,`tran_date`,`term_id`,`term_serial_no`) COMMENT '唯一索引：交易日期+终端编号+终端流水号',
  KEY `idx_term_bizlog` (`tran_day`,`term_id`,`term_date`,`term_serial_no`) COMMENT '终端查询索引：终端编号+终端日期+终端流水号'
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='联机交易流水表'
